STI — Industrial Networking
STI-488XGGPM2B-2BT
8-port L2+ managed industrial PoE++ switch with hardware fiber bypass.
Key Differentiators
Fiber Bypass — Network continuity on power failure
Power failure or hardware fault triggers automatic optical bypass in ≤10ms — traffic flows directly between upstream and downstream devices as if the switch isn't there. Non-negotiable for power, transportation, and industrial automation where downtime has real operational cost.
PoE++ 90W + ERPS G.8032
Up to 90W per port (ports 1–2) for high-draw PDs. ERPS ring protection recovers in ≤20ms. Two independent redundancy layers on a single device.
10G SFP+ multi-rate uplinks
4× SFP+ ports support 1G / 2.5G / 10G auto-negotiation — uplink bandwidth scales to match aggregation layer without module changes.

STI — Industrial Networking
STI-288DGGPM
8-port PoE+ industrial switch with native DI/DO/RS485 I/O and dual 1G/2.5G SFP uplinks — 240W total PoE budget.
Key Differentiators
Native DI/DO/RS485 — no external serial gateway needed
Removable 8-pin terminal block integrates 1-ch digital input (12–30V), 1-ch digital output (relay/pulse, 2A@30VDC), and RS485 Modbus RTU transparent transmission. Connect PLCs, RTUs, meters, and field sensors directly over TCP/IP without an additional gateway device.
Dual 1G/2.5G SFP uplinks with ERPS ring protection
Multi-rate SFP slots support 1GBase-X and 2.5GBase-X — same hardware adapts to both existing 1G fiber infrastructure and 2.5G backbone upgrades. G.8032 ERPS delivers ≤20ms failover across fiber ring topologies.
8× PoE+ with intelligent per-port power management
All RJ45 ports support IEEE 802.3af/at up to 30W per port, 240W total. Per-port PoE priority, PD watchdog, and power scheduling enable unattended fault recovery — no on-site intervention required.
